importar.hecho: Done. This was added to your database:
importar.confirmarTexto: The data of “{nombre}” is swapped for the file's and the app restarts. A backup is made first, which you can restore from Settings.
importar.nadaDisponible: Not available: {motivo}. Since this file carries only a part, it cannot replace your data either.
importar.revisarAyuda: Compares the file with your data and you decide what stays: new, different, deleted and what clashes.
importar.revisarNada: Comparing changes nothing: your data is written only when you apply what you decided.

error.ya_existe: A .boldo file with that name already exists. Choose another name.

diferente.ayuda: The same record with other data. You can decide per record or field by field.

nuevo.ayuda: Only in the file. They come in unless you uncheck them.

masivo.mantener_todo: Leave everything as in my database
